column1: 5.5.4.6.8 Performing Emitter Identification. This enables the user to perform the
Emitter Identification process in System Mode – FP and BITE Mode. The Emitter
identification will be performed by establishing the connection with the database of Emitter
library, which will be built in Postgre SQL database. This will display the Emitter
Identification Search results that are obtained by performing level search. The Emitter
Identity window shows list of Emitters in library matching with intercepted emitter. Emitters
matching with confidence level greater than set confidence threshold are only shown.
Emitter identification results are prioritized based on confidence level of match. The
details of Radar ID, Radar Name, Mode, Platform, and Confidence Level of Identification
